name: Evidently Open Source ML Monitoring
free_limit: Free Apache-2.0 Python ML/LLM evaluation framework with 100+ metrics, local reports and self-hosted monitoring dashboard; no vendor-hosted row quota for the self-managed software.
watch_out: Self-hosting requires your own compute, storage and operations. Evidently Cloud, team collaboration, alerting and enterprise features are separate hosted/paid offerings; optional external LLM judge APIs can incur charges.
